Episode 201. The Initiated Invasion (3)
When Dante first realized the attack of the alien invaders in the conference room, Hedo was in the castle's waiting room watching the dragons.
Therefore, while Dante's attack was focusing the red fleet on the front shields, he could aim for the rear.
In some ways, it was better for Hedo that Dante had left with the dragon knights and dragons. He didn't need to fight thinking about the lives of the dragon knights and dragons.
From the initial bombardment to now, Hedo had been swinging his sword to save the dragons and dragon knights.
But now, he had to focus only on the attack. His enemies could not afford to even look at Dante and the retreating dragon knights.

Dante is one of the world's finest warriors. While he was fighting with the fleet, he did not need to worry about the impact flowing through Dante's ranks. In other words, he could fight as much as he wanted.
Squeak.
Hedo revealed his teeth and smiled. The power of his long sword shone brightly and spread a vast energy.

His unique muscles swelled instantly. Hard, thick skin, and the muscle fibers hidden beneath it were taut like dense needles. The muscles writhing ferociously with every move could focus their strength at any point.

When that power entered his sword, it seemed like it could cut anything, and when it entered his grip, it seemed like it could tear anything. Like checking a massive machine, Hedo briefly examined his body. His entire body was ready to follow him perfectly.
He was ready to explode.
Kwang-!
Several bombardments hit Hedo directly. But the alien invaders could not penetrate his enormous physique and bounced off into the air.
Hedo caught the scattering alien invaders and brutally tore them apart, at which sight the alien invaders inside the ship couldn't help but flinch.
'What the hell is that... Is that a human?'
'Repelling fleet fire with his bare body without a shield? Crazy, he's leaping onto the ship! Even though the sky is filled with the energy released by our Drak brethren...!'

Even though it wasn't the bombardment of the flagship Baryon, it was far beyond the understanding of the alien invaders. To withstand the energy released by the flagship Baryon, they had to have at least the defensive power of the red fleet.
It meant that Hedo's body was harder than a ship. Moreover, this monstrous human was now even releasing sword energy.

The sword energy, which erupted from the realm of his swordsmanship and strength, was flooding the fleet like a tidal wave. The bombardment aimed at Dante and the dragon knights lost their orbit under the pressure of the swordsmanship, and the ships closest to Hedo momentarily tilted and were pushed back.

His swordsmanship momentarily blocked the fleet's view. When the leftmost, frontmost ship regained its view, the first thing that caught the aliens' eyes was Hedo, who had leaped up to the command deck.
"Intercept! Start the Thorn while intercepting!"

From the left and right of the spaceship, cannons stretched out and fired spherical shells at Hedo. However, they couldn't possibly stand a chance against Hedo's muscles, which the main guns hadn't even managed to pierce. Hedo stabbed his sword into the ship without dodging the shells.
Fizzzzzzz-!

At the same time, the ship's electrical shield, called 'Thorn', was deployed. It was a device to shake off enemies directly attached to the ship, which held enough power to knock off even decent dragons in an instant.
But even that was just a minor annoyance to Hedo. He exploded his energy into the blade stabbed into the ship and destroyed it.
Like crushed walnuts, the enemy tribe members popped out from the wrecked ship. Some tried to leap to another ship for survival, and others rushed towards Hedo in an attempt to stop him.

However, all of them met the same fate. Enemies who approached were sliced in a single stroke, and Sword Qi was launched at those who retreated. The pieces of enemy tribesmen swept away by the Sword Qi jumped onto nearby ships, creating a gruesome scene.
"Let's smash them all!"

Hedo gripped the ship's bridge with his left hand. Although it was shattered by the recent explosion, the bridge was easily ten times bigger than him. Hedo was lifting it like a rock and throwing it at the ship next to him.
The crew on the next ship blinked their eyes. Did a human just lift a destroyed bridge with his hands and throw it? As that thought crossed their minds, Hedo's face, now much closer, came into view.
"Ugh, choke!"

Boom! Hedo broke the glass with a punch, grabbed the enemy tribe member's neck, and twisted it. Then, with the sword in his mouth, he grabbed the hole in the glass with both hands and demonstrated his monstrous strength, ripping the ship apart.
ROAR-!
The moment Hedo's roar ended, the ship split in half and continued falling towards the ground. He literally tore the ship apart like a piece of paper.
Already two ships have been sunk. Including the one initially attacked from behind, a total of four ships were destroyed, leaving the enemy tribe in confusion.
Aircrafts are certainly the strongest weapons of war, but they are not suitable for close combat.
Whether in ancient or modern times, the reason why fleets are strong is that they can attack unilaterally from long distances and have excellent maneuverability.
The problem was that the distance was too close from the beginning.

Even for someone like Hedo, if he had to withstand the precise attack of the ship from tens of miles away, he wouldn't have been able to approach so easily. Of course, there would be fewer than ten people in the world who could do this even in a close combat situation like now.
While tearing up the ships in mid-air, Hedo constantly scattered Sword Qi to twist the flagship's attacks aimed at Dante.
It would have been slightly better if the Drac, excluding the flagship, had aimed at Dante with about a hundred ships. Hedo alone couldn't twist the shots of that many fleets.
"Abandon the Sword Emperor. From now on, all fleets prepare to strike Hedo from a distance. I will personally keep him tied up."
Drac quickly adjusted his orders. He judged that if the battle continued as is, unnecessary fleet losses would be inevitable.
He decided to abandon Dante and the Dragon Knights altogether, and focus on ending Hedo.
As the bridge of the flagship Barion opened, Hedo took a breath as he leaped onto the bridge of a nearby ship. The gazes of the two clashed in the space between the ships.
The shelling stopped. The flagship Barion no longer fired at Dante and the dragons, and the red brain that dyed the sky was also subsiding.
"So, finally the captain is stepping in."
"The world today is truly astonishing."
"If you're surprised, go back to the underground quietly and live as if you're dead. As long as the Vamel Alliance exists, the enemy tribe will not be the loser of this world again."

"I don't understand. Why would a human like you risk his life to protect this worthless fortress? The humans and dragons we originally wanted to take are nothing more than worthless meat compared to you and the Sword Emperor."
"I am the kind of person who is used to protecting something."
"Why did you only let the Sword Emperor escape? If you've given up on the other humans and dragons, you could have escaped together."
"That's an obvious reason. The Sword Emperor went to call for reinforcements. I'm talking about the owner of the name the enemy tribe fears the most."
"Jin Runcandel... I heard from my compatriots near the Rakiman and Fatlock Castles, he is indeed a problem. Do you have confidence that you can hold off me and the fleet until he arrives?"
"Absolutely."
"Right. You do have the strength that makes me believe you can. However, unfortunately, the problem is that I happen to be your opponent. It's time to wake up from the illusion."
The moment Drac finished speaking, Hedo instinctively sensed danger and drew his sword.
It seemed like a surprise attack. If it was a surprise attack that started like this, right in front of him, Hedo could have blocked it even if the opponent was a giant.
So he thought he had blocked it, but he felt like something chilly had brushed past him.
'What? I didn't see anything. Was it my imagination?'
He quickly tried to awaken his whole body's senses, but he didn't feel anything. He wasn't cut anywhere, and he didn't take any hits.
But the next moment.
'Blood!? Blood is...!'
Hedo could see 'blood' leaking from his body. For some reason, droplets of blood were spreading all over his body and floating in the air.
Hedo quickly formed a barrier, but the blood ignored the physical force and dispersed as particles, exiting the barrier towards Drac.
Drac smirked as if he had anticipated Hedo's reaction.
"Vampire. Before being sealed, many immortals and mortals in the world called me that."
Blood sucking, that was the unique ability Drac had as a Battle King.
Hedo instinctively threw his body to the ground to create distance.
'The speed of blood loss has definitely slowed down since the distance has increased. It's hopeless to fight him up close.'
The problem was that the power Drac held was not the only issue.
"Why, suddenly in a hurry? You seem eager to create distance."
Drac had already secured a spot on the ground before Hedo and was swinging his spear. Hedo barely avoided the spear, but had to confirm that more blood was being lost than before.
Although it was not noticeable for now, if it continued like this, his movements would inevitably slow down. Beyond that, he could even face death.
Moreover, the fleet was following Drac's orders, widening their ranks and backing off. Soon the fleet would start firing again from a distance where Hedo's sword couldn't reach.
'If I stick close to him, he sucks my blood quickly, and if I move away, it becomes easier for the fleet to attack me....'
He was caught in a dilemma.

'Since it seems like he's given up on the Sword Emperor, the best thing might be to hold out until the Sword Emperor gets to a safe area and then run away. Jin will find out the escape route and chase after us anyway when he arrives.'
Drac saw through all of this.

"You probably chose to hold out and then run away. But Hedo, our fleet can precisely strike only you, even if you and I are fighting close. I saw you handle the bombardment well with your bare body, can you continue to do so?"
Hedo didn't answer, instead scattering his sword energy and retreating. He felt a strange sensation as if blood was sloshing around inside his body.

He couldn't easily maintain the 'distance where blood is not absorbed'. Drac's spear continuously exploded the enemy brains, hindering Hedo's movement. If he had to counter, inevitably getting close to Drac, more blood was undeniably drained.
"What a disgusting ability."
Drac stretched out his long tongue and licked the blood that had dripped into the air.
"Ah, such rich blood.... The knights and dragons I originally intended to consume can't even compare. Today, my brethren and I will have a feast with your blood, Hedo."
